Jewish Cemetery of Carmagnola

Cemetery · Carmagnola, Italy

In 1863 the Jewish cemetery became an independent sector of the municipal cemetery. It is a small plot of land with triangular layout with simple in-ground graves and a few, more monumental family tombs located along the perimeter wall. The Jewish section is reached through the municipal cemetery Opening hours: October 1st – March 31st: daily, 8 am – 5 pm / Wednesday 8 am – 12 pm (afternoon closed) April 1st – September 30th: daily 8 am – 6 pm / Wednesday 8 am – 12 pm (afternoon closed) Jewish section closed on Saturdays and Jewish holidays Contacts: tel. +39 011 9770763 Guided tours on request: Jewish Community of Turin segreteria@torinoebraica.it https://torinoebraica.it/turismo/?lang=en Guided visits are available.
